_readme: Hand-curated Campaign facts. Every value here was taken from docs/campaign/* (OPS_NPC_EVENTS.md, ID_CHECK_2026-10-02.md, README.md, WORK_QUEUE.md) or the Fandom dump. Anything not established is null/'unknown' - never fill a gap by estimating. ev = evidence letters: C capture, D client DAT/decompile, W wiki, S server SQL/Lua. Edit this file, then run scripts/build_campaign_domain.py.

systems.label: Enlistment / allegiance
systems.gaps: Kolin-Olin (event 306) start params are live nation-state snapshots; not built.

systems.label: Sigil NPCs
systems.gaps: Windurst Sigil NPC (Mindala-Andola) sits at 0,0,0 in DSP npc_list (not placed). TextIDs swept +2 on 2026-10-02, not live-tested.

systems.label: Campaign Ops menu
systems.gaps: Menu runs with its text but does not record which op was chosen; mask/count replies not decoded; op credits do not regenerate.

systems.label: Op missions (246 rows)
systems.gaps: No mission scripts exist in LSB, Topaz or DSP (campaign.lua only). Mission rows come from the wiki; none verified against captures yet.

systems.label: Campaign Battles
systems.gaps: 34 campaign-battle captures are ingested; build state of the battle engine is not recorded in the research docs. Determine whether LSB campaign_system runs a live campaign (WORK_QUEUE item 4).

systems.label: Evaluation / promotion (rank-up)
systems.gaps: 12 evaluation-promotion captures are ingested but no document identifies the rank-up NPC, its csids or menu options. Needs analysis of the captures.

systems.label: Leader / policy / strategy voting
systems.gaps: 4 voting captures ingested (Windurst); NPC (a capture title names Kuron Makaron) and csids not analysed.

systems.label: Recon / news reports
systems.gaps: Dallus-Mallus (event 323) reports are fixed tables in captures; live nation-state values are not derivable.

systems.label: Allied Notes shops / temp items
systems.gaps: Wiki item lists exist (San d'Oria / Windurst Campaign Items); shop NPCs, stock and prices not verified against the client.

systems.label: Field teleport (Allied Notes cost)
systems.gaps: Costs are documented on the wiki only; NPC and csid not identified.

npcs.name: (rank-up NPC not identified)
npcs.gaps: Captures titled 'Windurst Promotion', 'Failed Evaluation 1st Medal', 'Failed Evaluation but retain rank' exist. Identify the NPC and csids from them.

menus.label: Main Ops menu (SD / Windurst)
menus.note: p0 = Op Credits, p1 = 1 once enlisted (0 = intro), p2 = 0, p3 = 1. Slot reply masks not decoded.

menus.label: Abandon current op
menus.note: Two yes/no prompts; yes/no handling not decoded.

menus.label: Recon / policy report
menus.note: EndPara 0..8 triggers 9 sequential updates; fixed tables.

rewards.label: Op Credits
rewards.note: Wiki: 1 per 24h, max 7, 1 spent per op, no refund. Server stores char var CampaignOpCredits, new player = 1; NO regeneration built.

rewards.label: Allied Notes
rewards.note: Earned from Ops, Campaign Battles, SCNM, Copper Voucher. Earn/spend not verified against the client.

rewards.label: Ribbon line (4 levels)
rewards.note: Bronze Ribbon of Service, Brass Ribbon of Service, Allied Ribbon of Bravery, Allied Ribbon of Glory.

rewards.label: Star line (4 levels)
rewards.note: Bronze Star, Sterling Star, Mythril Star, Golden Star.

rewards.label: Emblem line (4 levels)
rewards.note: Copper Emblem of Service, Iron Emblem of Service, Steelknight Emblem, Holyknight Emblem.

rewards.label: Wings line (4 levels)
rewards.note: Brass Wings of Service, Mythril Wings of Service, Wings of Integrity, Wings of Honor.

rewards.label: Medal line (4 levels)
rewards.note: Starlight Medal, Moonlight Medal, Dawnlight Medal, Medal of Altana.

rewards.label: Allied Tags / temp items
rewards.note: Worn in Campaign Battles; temp items bought with Allied Notes are lost on leaving the area.

open_questions: Medal key items are believed to be ids 924-943 but have NOT been verified: run `python id_bridge.py keyitem "<name>"` for each (90% drift between LSB and Topaz).
Who is the rank-up / evaluation NPC in each nation, and which csids and menu options do the promotion captures show?
Are there any Campaign quests at all? None are recorded in the research so far; do not invent any.
Does LSB campaign_system run a live campaign or only script-set values (WORK_QUEUE item 4)?
XP + Allied Notes thresholds to rank up are unknown (the wiki table asks players to submit them).
